metrics.spendingRatio: How much of your planned budget you have already spent in this cycle, shown as a percentage (actual spending ÷ planned budget).
metrics.cycleProgress: How far through the current statement you are today, shown as a percentage of days elapsed out of the total cycle length.
metrics.projectedCycleSpending: An estimate of what your total spending will be by the end of the cycle, based on your pace so far. Compared against your planned budget target.
metrics.plannedBudget: The total amount you planned to spend across all categories in this cycle.
metrics.safeDaily: A suggested daily spending limit for the rest of the cycle, calculated from the budget you have left to spend divided by the remaining days.
metrics.safeDailyBudget: Your remaining flexible (non-essential) budget divided by the days left in the cycle. Try to stay at or below this per day to stay on plan.
metrics.safeDailyCash: Your available cash/bank balance in your base currency (after essential bills) divided by the days left in the cycle. The most you can actually afford per day.
metrics.totalBaseEquivalent: The combined balance of all your accounts, converted to your base currency at today's display rate so you can see everything in one currency.
metrics.savingOnTrack: On Track — your projected savings for this cycle meet or exceed your target.
metrics.savingWarning: Pace Warning — you're projected to fall short of your saving target. Slow down spending.
metrics.savingOverspending: Over Budgeting — at this pace you will miss your saving target by a wide margin. Cut spending now.
metrics.budgetBreakdownPlanned: The amount you allocated to this category for the cycle.
metrics.budgetBreakdownSpent: What you have actually spent in this category so far this cycle.
metrics.budgetBreakdownRemaining: Planned minus Spent. Positive means you still have room; negative (red) means you have gone over.
